title: Cohomology on a colimit of sites
statement:
In the situation of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites] (a cofiltered $\mathcal I$, sites $\mathcal C_i$ with finite coverings, morphisms of sites $f_a$ given by $u_a$, the colimit site $\mathcal C$ with $f_i:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C_i$ given by $u_i$), let $\mathcal F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $\mathcal C_i$ for every $i$, and for $a:j\to i$ let $\varphi_a:f_a^{-1}\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F_j$ be a map of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal C_j$, with $\varphi_c=\varphi_b\circ f_b^{-1}\varphi_a$ whenever $c=a\circ b$. The maps $f_j^{-1}\varphi_a:f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i=f_j^{-1}f_a^{-1}\mathcal F_i\to f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j$ make $(f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i)$ a filtered system of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal C$; set $\mathcal F=\varinjlim f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then for every $i$, every $X_i\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C_i)$ and every $p\ge0$ the canonical map
$$\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}H^p(u_a(X_i),\mathcal F_j)\longrightarrow H^p(u_i(X_i),\mathcal F)$$
is an isomorphism ($H^p$ over an object, [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]); the map sends the class of $\xi\in H^p(u_a(X_i),\mathcal F_j)$ to the image of $\xi$ under the pullback along $f_j$ ($H^p(u_a(X_i),\mathcal F_j)\to H^p(u_j(u_a(X_i)),f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j)$, induced by the adjunction unit $\mathcal F_j\to f_{j*}f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j$ on an injective resolution, [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback]) followed by the coprojection $f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j\to\mathcal F$, with $u_j(u_a(X_i))=u_i(X_i)$. The colimit on the left is over the category of arrows $a:j\to i$ of $\mathcal I$ (cofiltered, so the colimit is filtered), the transition map for $b:k\to j$ being $H^p(\varphi_b)\circ f_b^*:H^p(u_a(X_i),\mathcal F_j)\to H^p(u_b(u_a(X_i)),f_b^{-1}\mathcal F_j)\to H^p(u_{a\circ b}(X_i),\mathcal F_k)$.

proof.text: Apply finite-stage class existence and finite-stage detection of zero to the canonical cocone c. The former asserts every target class is c_t(x); the latter supplies a transition killing any x with c_t(x)=0. These are independent halves of the continuity argument, not a restatement of the comparison being an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 09YP (lemma-colimit), with the right-exact diagram in Tag 0739; online copies at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YP and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0739

proof.text: Every element z of colim D has a stage representative x (Mathlib Concrete.colimit_exists_rep). If desc(c)(z)=0, the coprojection equation implies c_t(x)=0. Choose b:t→t′ with D(b)(x)=0. The colimit transition equation gives z=ι_t′(D(b)(x))=0. Thus the homomorphism has trivial kernel and is injective (injective_iff_map_eq_zero).
For each y choose x,t with c_t(x)=y. Then ι_t(x) maps to y by colimit.ι_desc, giving surjectivity. A bijective abelian-group morphism is an isomorphism (Mathlib ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective).

split_report.summary: Proof written from Stacks Cohomology on Sites 09YP (sites-cohomology.tex 2905-2944) in five steps: the systems and the canonical map (well defined by naturality and composition of the pullback on cohomology); p = 0 by Sites 09YN; the injective system of 0EXZ with its cokernel system and the exact sequence of colimit sheaves (exactness of f_i^{-1} and of filtered colimits in Ab(C)); vanishing of H^q(U, colim f_i^{-1}G_i) via Cech cohomology (every covering of C comes from some C_i, Cech complex of the colimit = colimit of Cech complexes, injectives Cech-acyclic, filtered colimits exact, Cech vanishing criterion 03F9 with B = Ob(C), Cov = Cov(C)); and the dimension-shifting induction of Lemma 0739 written out as a step (five lemma). Statement clarified: transition maps of the colimit system made explicit and the pullback cited as a node. New nodes: general-site versions of 03F9, 03AW and the Cech complex (the existing ones are for the small etale site), 09YN, 0EXZ, the Cech-complex identification, the pullback on cohomology along a morphism of sites, and exactness of filtered colimits in Ab(C) (Mathlib leaf Sheaf.hasExactColimitsOfShape). Mathlib has nothing on colimits of sites (LeanSearch, LeanFinder, Loogle, grep); the source repository has no Lean for this.

Statement clarified with the transition maps of the system. The etale-site Cech nodes were not reused because they are stated for the small etale site only (stage-3 merge candidates: general-site versions subsume them).
